The integration of these pathways implies that Tiotropium may influence Slc22a5 through its interaction with Ipratropium Bromide, which in turn affects the expression or function of Slc22a5. The evidence highlights a mechanistic link between Tiotropium and Slc22a5, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated.
